slots.name: concerned parties count
slots.sentence: The situation has sparked concerns among state election officials in both parties. And it’s alarmed Democrats in the Capitol, who have launched a broad campaign to prepare local election officials and state attorneys general to defy any administrative effort to disrupt voting or corrupt the election results.
